items.title: Surjectivity criterion for morphisms of spectral Deligne-Mumford stacks
items.statement_scope: Whole Proposition 1.1.20: for a morphism f: X -> Y of spectral Deligne-Mumford stacks, the following conditions are equivalent: (1) every geometric morphism eta*: S -> Y factors through f*: X -> Y; (2) for every field k and every map eta: Spec k -> Y there exists a field extension K of k such that Spec K -> Spec k -> Y factors through f; (3) for every field k and every map eta: Spec k -> Y, the fiber product Spec k times_Y X is nonempty.

standard_prerequisites: Infinity-topos points and geometric morphisms; Proposition 1.1.15 (author PDF p. 8).
Remark 1.1.17 factorization of a geometric point into a minimal geometric point and a separable closure (author PDF pp. 9-10).
Fields, field extensions, residue fields of tensor products, and fiber products of spectral Deligne-Mumford stacks.
items.difficulty_reason: Rule author-work-bearing-core-v1-20261114: H2 because the proof at author PDF p. 10 contains a concrete non-routine field-extension argument: starting from an arbitrary geometric point eta: Spec k -> Y, it reduces to k separably closed, factors the underlying geometric morphism through X, uses Proposition 1.1.15 to obtain a minimal geometric point eta': Spec k' -> X, compares the two minimal points of Y via Remark 1.1.17 and the homotopy of pushforward functors, obtains an isomorphism k_0 = k'_0, and then takes a residue field K of k tensor_{k_0} k' to produce the required lift. This is more than a routine equivalence of definitions, but it is a supporting criterion rather than an H3 construction.

difficulty_evidence.bearing_core: Field-extension and minimal-geometric-point comparison: reduction to separably closed k, comparison of eta and f composed with eta' via Remark 1.1.17, isomorphism of separably closed subfields, and passage to a residue field of k tensor_{k_0} k'.
